_readme: Single source of truth for facts used across the site. Every fact carries a status. confirmed = use as-is. tbc = render it, but show a dev-only 'TBC' badge when NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOW_TODO=true. hold = do NOT render anywhere until the client confirms it.

founded.note: The old prototype said 1998 / 27 years. That is WRONG. Never use 1998.

starExportHouse.value: Star Export House, Government of India

markets.note: Nabeen is strongest in Nigeria (Kano). Nabeen has been part of Nigeria's community for over a decade.

phonePrimary.note: Appears in brochure, Facebook and prototype.

whatsapp.prefill: Hello Nabeen team, I would like to know more about your fabrics.
whatsapp.note: Assumed to be the primary phone. Confirm which number is on WhatsApp.

emailSecondary.note: Brochure only. Ask whether to show a gmail address publicly.

address.mapsQuery: B-90 Gopal Gully Mangaldas Market Mumbai 400002
address.note: Facebook page and prototype use B-90 Gopal Gully. Brochure (2023) says 355, Mangaldas Mkt, 7th New Lane, Mumbai-02. Confirm before launch - the Directions button depends on it.

brandFilm._note: The client's own reel from the Nabeen Facebook page. The source MP4 has been supplied and is in brand-kit/assets/video/ and public/video/: 720x1280 (9:16), 21.5s, H.264, 4.5MB. Because it is vertical it is never cropped into a landscape band; it plays as a standing panel on the home hero and on this page. Still tbc: whether the caption may be used as written, and whether a smaller encode can be supplied for mobile data.
brandFilm.caption: Made from the finest Egyptian Giza cotton to luxury jacquard fabric, Marconi by Nabeen ensures not all whites are made equal.

wear2care._note: Photographs from the client's own Wear2Care x Ali Nuhu donation, supplied 2026-09-22. They replace the placeholders on the home cause section and the Nabeen x Ali Nuhu page. The recipients named below are read off the banner in the photographs themselves: confirm the spelling, and confirm they may be named on the site.

testimonials._note: Texts are from the brochure (p.8), which gives no names. The home page needs 5-6. The prototype's named testimonials (Mr. Obum O., Mr. Alin, Mr. Mohammed A.) are UNVERIFIED - do not use them.

items.quote: Nabeen fabrics are absolutely amazing and good quality. Huge shoutout to the DJI team.
Top notch fabrics by Nabeen. I am blessed to partner with Nabeen and team. Excellent selection of designs, quality and colours.
Our customers love Nabeen. They are trustworthy and transparent. Super customer experience and support. God bless.
Nabeen supports small businesses and businesswomen. Excellent team.

fabricTypes._note: How the brand describes its range publicly (Instagram/Facebook bio + Fabric Journal). Proposed as the primary way to browse the range. Structure needs client approval. The one-line descriptions are PROPOSED microcopy written for the site, not client text - get them approved.

items.name: Voile & Jacquard
items.line: Light voiles and woven jacquard patterns.

signatureLines._note: CONFLICT: the About Nabeen PDF and the 2023 brochure group the range differently. Build the Nabeen page from 'fourLines' (the more detailed, newer document) but keep the data swappable. Do not merge or guess mappings between the two.

socialCause.headline: Nabeen sponsors a share of its profits towards child education in Nigeria.
socialCause.body: Nabeen® contributes a percentage of its profits to support child education in Nigeria. Every dollar you spend with Nabeen goes towards shaping a brighter future for Nigeria.

percentage.note: Client material says 'a percentage (%)'. Never invent a number.
